name: crit-plus
description: crit+: browser-based code and Markdown review, story walkthroughs, and structured human decisions. An enhanced fork of Crit by Tomasz Tomczyk.

author.name: JesseGuoX; based on Crit by Tomasz Tomczyk

interface.shortDescription: Review code, refine plans, and make decisions
interface.longDescription: crit+ brings browser-based code and Markdown review to Codex, with inline comments, chaptered story walkthroughs, and review rounds. It adds a refreshed Markdown layout with wide-screen support and structured decision pages: compare options and recommendations, choose an option, or request changes. Agents read submitted decisions and continue with the choices you made; unanswered items stay pending. Includes four skills and a proposed-plan review hook. Requires the crit-plus CLI on PATH. Maintained by JesseGuoX as an enhanced fork of Crit, originally created by Tomasz Tomczyk (https://github.com/tomasz-tomczyk/crit). The upstream MIT license and copyright are preserved.
interface.developerName: JesseGuoX; based on Crit by Tomasz Tomczyk
defaultPrompt: Use $crit-plus to review my current code changes.
